fail.log: It is only wood. You run a hand over it anyway, and your palm remembers the shape.

choices.text: Carry the child up a floor on your back

choices.text: Tell the child to go home

events.text: A beast tamer kneels on the {tw_floor} floor, holding a torn sleeve to her arm. Her mountain cat has gone wild in the iron cages and strikes at anyone who comes near. "Please do not kill her," she says. "She is all I have." The cat leaps at the wrong moment, and you fall with it.

choices.text: Kill the cat; it is dangerous

effects.log: It is quick. The tamer does not say a word, and that is worse than anything she could have said.

events.text: A pack of thin dogs waits on the {tw_floor} floor around a single bowl of rice. They are starving. So, after a hard climb, are you. You clear the floor hungry. The dogs watch you to see what you will do.

choices.text: Give them the rice

effects.log: They eat it in a breath and look at you with something like worship. Dogs are easy to please. That is why it matters.

choices.text: Share it evenly, you included

effects.log: Nine dogs and you. It comes to a few grains each. It is the best meal you have had all year.

choices.text: Eat it yourself

effects.log: The dogs lie down without a sound. Rice has never tasted so bad.
